user.title: Add your vehicle
user.description: Select your vehicle's odometer. Mobility Forecast uses your driving history to predict future distances.

reconfigure.title: Change odometer
reconfigure.description: Existing history is preserved. Readings from a discontinuous replacement are rejected; select a continuous vehicle odometer.

error.invalid_source: Select a numeric lifetime cumulative odometer in km or mi that never resets daily; not range, trip or walking distance.

calendars.title: Calendars
calendars.description: Calendars are optional. Waze sends origin and destination locations to an external service, never event titles. Install Waze Travel Time first. [Learn more about calendar predictions](https://github.com/LickABrick/mobility-forecast/blob/master/docs/calendar-routing.md#setup).

data_description.ignore_nested_appointments: Ignores fully contained appointments. May also exclude genuine separate journeys.

routing.title: Waze region
routing.description: Choose the region of your Home Assistant installation. [Learn more about Waze regions](https://github.com/LickABrick/mobility-forecast/blob/master/docs/calendar-routing.md#waze).

add_location.title: Add location
add_location.description: Enter a full street address with city, or latitude,longitude. [Learn more about known locations](https://github.com/LickABrick/mobility-forecast/blob/master/docs/calendar-routing.md#known-locations).

ev.title: Electric vehicle
ev.description: Appointment addresses may be sent to PDOK and destination coordinates to NDW. No titles or descriptions are sent. Explicit consent is required for public charging; disable at any time. Enter usable, not nominal capacity. [Learn more about EV setup](https://github.com/LickABrick/mobility-forecast/blob/master/docs/ev-charging.md#setup).

data_description.preferred_max_soc: Normal maximum battery percentage after charging, not charging power.
data_description.minimum_soc: Battery percentage you prefer to preserve after driving.
data_description.external_lookup_consent: Sends destination addresses to PDOK and coordinates to NDW, not titles or descriptions.

data.minimum_appointment_minutes: Minimum appointment duration to consider charging (min)
data.allow_above_preferred_soc: Allow higher targets for long journeys

data_description.minimum_appointment_minutes: Shorter appointments are not considered charging opportunities.
data_description.prefer_long_sessions: A preference; cannot override reachability or reserve constraints.

data_description.range_entity: Same-device suggestions only; review the meaning before selecting.

error.routing_unavailable: Install Waze Travel Time before enabling routes.
error.invalid_location: Enter a full address with street number and city, or valid coordinates.
error.duplicate_location: This location name already exists. Choose Edit location.
error.invalid_ev: Invalid EV value or incompatible entity unit.
error.consent_required: Consent is required for external lookups.
error.invalid_number: Enter a finite number within the indicated range.
error.invalid_soc_sensor: Select a battery sensor reporting percent.
error.invalid_reserve: Reserve must be below the preferred charging limit.
error.invalid_time: Enter a valid home charging time.

source.title: Odometer not found
source.description: The selected odometer could not be found. Check the original vehicle integration or reconfigure Mobility Forecast. Existing history has been preserved.

storage.title: Vehicle history could not be read
storage.description: Persistent vehicle history is unreadable. Writes have been stopped to preserve the file. Restore a Home Assistant backup or remove and re-add this vehicle to start fresh.

resetting_counter.title: Distance counter resets detected
resetting_counter.description: This sensor appears to reset its distance counter. Mobility Forecast requires a cumulative odometer that does not reset daily. Reconfigure the source; existing history is preserved.

get_history.name: Get mileage history
get_history.description: Read-only mileage data without calendar content.

entry_id.name: Vehicle config entry
entry_id.description: Config entry ID for the vehicle.

get_forecast.name: Get distance forecast
get_forecast.description: Read-only mileage data without calendar content.

entry_id.name: Vehicle config entry
entry_id.description: Config entry ID for the vehicle.

days.name: Days
days.description: Number of local forecast dates (1–365); default 30, capped by available data.

get_ev_plan.name: Get EV charging plan
get_ev_plan.description: Read-only charging recommendation; no vehicle control.

sync_now.name: Sync now
sync_now.description: Runs an immediate bounded synchronization cycle.
